tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi bskang bshag bzlog bskul bstod pa dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bsam don kun 'grub 'phrin las mkha' khyab ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza tsakra sam+ba rā ya/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i lhag pa'i lha mchog dpal 'khor lo bde mchog la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūm̐ bde chen lhun grub chos dbyings pho brang nas/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes keng rus 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /nor skyong yab yum dbugs len bye ba 'bum/ /sde brgyad yang bran dang bcas bdag la dgongs/ /zhing skyong yab yum 'khor bcas mnyes byed pa'i/ /mchod rdzas dngos 'byor yid sprul bsam mi khyab/ /sa dang bar snang yongs su gang ba 'di/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /'byung ba rim brtsegs rak+ta'i rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /keng rus ri rab thod mkhar gzhal yas khang / /sna tshogs drag po'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa 'di/ /nor skyong yab yum 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /rin chen thod snod mkha' ltar yangs pa'i nang / /sha khrag ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi sogs/ /ro brgya sbyar ba'i gtor ma ri ltar spungs/ /byin rlabs bzhed dgu 'byung ba 'di bzhes shig /khrag chen zhag dang chang rgod rgun chang sogs/ /bdud rtsi'i btung ba sna tshogs mtsho ltar bskyil/ /ga pur gur gum tsan+dan dkar dmar dang / /dza ti la sogs dri bzang mang po'i tshogs/ /gzhan yang dkar nag spos dang sha chen sogs/ /sbyar ba'i spos dud sprin ltar 'thibs se 'thibs/ /mda' mdung ral gri la sogs mtshon cha dang / /khrab rmog gzhib sogs go cha bsam mi khyab/ /nas 'bras rgya ja la sogs 'bru sna dang / /la si sing sogs gos dang dar zab tshogs/ /gser g.yu la sogs rin chen sna tshogs rnams/ /la la ri ltar spungs pas rngams mtho zhing / /la la 'bru yi phung po brdal ba tsam/ /rnga chen dung chen sil snyan gling bu sogs/ /snyan zhing gzi brjid ldan pa'i rol mo dang /

/ting 'dzin brtan pa'i dbyangs kyi nga ro sogs/ /kun kyang nam mkha'i 'brug ltar 'u ru ru/ /gzhan yang rak+ta 'khyil ba'i mchod yon dang / /dbang po rnam lnga spungs pa'i me tog tshogs/ /tshil chen spos dang zhun chen sgron me 'bar/ /mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus zhal zas dang / /mi rkang gling bu'i sgra snyan 'tshe re re/ /khyung chen rma bya ne tso ngang pa sogs/ /spu sdug ldan pa'i bya tshogs mang po dang / /seṅge stag gzig dred dang 'phar ba sogs/ /mche sder rno ngar ldan pa'i gcan gzan tshogs/ /glang chen rta mchog ma he lug nag sogs/ /srog chags rnams kyang dbang po kun tshang zhing / /sna tshogs rgyan spras mang po shigs se shig /gzhan yang gling bzhi gling phran nyi zlar bcas/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad 'dod yon rnam lnga sogs/ /mdor na zhing skyong 'khor bcas mnyes byed pa'i/ /mthun rdzas sna tshogs ma tshang med pa 'di/ /nor skyong yab yum 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /dgyes pas bzhes nas bdag cag dpon slob la/ /'dod dgu'i dngos grub sna tshogs char ltar phob/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi tshe rabs thog med nas/ /rgyun chad med par bsags pa'i las ngan dang / /skye ba 'dir yang bcas dang rang bzhin gyi/ /nyes ltung ji snyed bsags pa mthol lo bshag /mthu ldan yab yum dregs byed 'khor bcas kyis/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin srung zhing skyong ba dang / /khyad par sngags 'chang bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /byang chub bar du mgon dang stong grogs mdzod/ /pha rol sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /log 'dren rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyis/ /bar du gcod pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus pa/ /bzlog go bsgyur ro bstan pa'i dgra la bh+yoḥ rab dkar nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid rnams/ /gcig tu bsdus ltar keng rus brjid pa'i sku/ /rin chen rgyan dang dar zab lhab lhub can/ /mthong bas yid 'phrog zhing skyong sku la bstod/ /ha ha'i bzhad sgras sa gzhi kun 'dar zhing /

/hūm̐ phaṭ sgra yis bdud snying tshal par 'gas/ /thos pa tsam gyis srid gsum dregs byed rnams/ /zil gyis gnon mdzad zhing skyong gsung la bstod/ /chos kun smra bsam brjod med yul 'das kyi/ /de bzhin nyid las nam yang ma g.yos kyang / /gdug pa 'dul phyir drag gtum tshul ston pa'i/ /bde gsal mi rtog zhing skyong thugs la bstod/ /sha za yab yum bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /dgra bo'i dbugs len bye ba 'bum phrag stong / /mthu rtsal ldan pa'i lha srin sde brgyad dang / /yang bran stong phrag brgyad cu la sogs pa/ /dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas bstod par bgyi/ /de ltar mchod cing bstod pas mnyes byas nas/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum 'khor bcas rnams/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /'jig rten khams 'dir bde skyid 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /tshe mthar phyin cing bsam don kun 'grub ste/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bstan pa rin chen 'di/ /mchog tu 'phel la phyi nang bar chad rnams/ /myur du zhi zhing bdag don lhun grub mdzod/ /ces dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi bskang bshag bzlog bskul bstod pa dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bsam don kun 'grub 'phrin las mkha' khyab ces bya ba 'di yang / snyigs dus kyi 'dren pa dam pa sbas pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can las/ chos skyong 'di'i rjes su gnang ba'i bka' drin nos shing / rje btsun rdo rje 'chang rgyal ba mus pa chen po las lugs 'di'i chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi bdud rtsi ngom par 'thungs pa'i skal ba bzang po can dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rang gi 'dod don 'ga' zhig bsgrub pa'i phyir/

shing mo glang lo zla ba bzhi pa'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes la dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi yang rtser sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa bkra shis don 'grub kyis bgyis so/ /'dis bdag cag dpon slob kyi bsam don 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig /ka l+yā na war+dhan+tu sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dpal dur bdag yab yum gyi bskang bshags bzlog bskul dang bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
